Coram : A.K. PATNAIK*, RANJANA PRAKASH DESAI
A B Penal Code, 1860 - s. 302 rlw s. 149 and s. 147 - Murder - Assault with lathis and dandas leading to death - Five accused including the three appellants - Conviction of C appellants by Courts below - Justification - Held: On facts, justified -Evidence of the three eye-witnesses (PWs1, 2 and 6) of PW-1 in the FIR within four hours of the incident clearly establish that the five accused persons including the three appellants had D assaulted the deceased with lathis and dandas when the hands and legs of the deceased were tied with a rope - PW- 3, PW-4 and PW-7 supported the prosecution
Decision Date : 01-10-2013 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1196/2007 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
